serverInfo.title: Sinaida Krivchenko — Portfolio MCP Server
serverInfo.description: Sinaida Krivchenko's new-media art practice for agents: bio, selected works and contact as read-only tools, plus three MCP Apps that render live in the chat: a gallery of works, a generative portrait of the conversation and the sky of past visits; two prompts, a project brief and a creative problem thought through with her method; the site's llms.txt and agent-data.json as resources.
